The '''Fourth Alsakan Conflict''' was a war between [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] that was part of a large [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series]] of events that began in [[17,000 BBY]]. Two notable battles during the conflict were the [[Defence of Drogheda]] in [[13,649 BBY]] and the [[Conquest of Manaan]] in [[13,220 BBY]].<ref name="EGW" />
